Share on X Telegram Supporters of the All Progressives Congress (APC) have thronged Ranchers Bees Stadium in Kaduna ahead of the flag-off of the party’s presidential campaign, with some spending the night on nearby streets in anticipation of the event.
As early as 6 a.m., supporters were already making their way to the stadium, creating a carnival-like atmosphere around the venue.
Some of the supporters reportedly slept on streets close to the stadium to secure their presence ahead of the campaign rally.
As of press time, the stadium was already filled with supporters awaiting the arrival of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, who is expected to arrive in Kaduna at 12 noon.
The rally marks the flag-off of the APC presidential campaign, with party supporters gathering to witness the event.
The atmosphere around the stadium remained lively as more supporters arrived ahead of the President’s expected arrival.
